第九章 秦龙的疯狂（三更完）
“完了……”
“这小家伙，竟然在这时候露出这么大的破绽！”秦家老祖摇了摇头，眼里透着一抹不忍，在他看来，秦轩这时候简直是必死无疑……
所有的人皆是不由得闭上双眼，摇头叹息。
“快看！”
就在这时，不知谁喊了一句，众人不由得再次抬头，这一看，顿时惊得差点眼珠子都要掉下来，就连秦家老祖也险些咬到舌头，目光死死的盯着崖顶。
只见崖顶不知何时出现一把巨剑的幻影，恐怖的气息使得崖顶狂风阵阵，或许别人不知道这一剑的威力，但是身在剑下的秦江伟却感受犹深，这简直压得他喘不过气来！
就在秦江伟疑惑少年为何能爆发如此强大力量时，那把黝黑的巨剑已经来到了他头顶，来不及多想，秦江伟连忙转攻为守，横剑往上迎去。
刚一接触，秦江伟顿时脸色狂变，只觉得剑上传来一股巨大的力量，身子一矮，嘭的一声，双膝跪倒在地上，地面上的碎石瞬间纷纷化为齑粉。
不过还未等他发怒，体内的玄气莫名一滞，就仿佛体内的玄气被某种东西封印住了一般，明明有足够的玄气，却根本无法调用，这一发现，顿时令秦江伟变得惊恐起来！
“就是现在！”
目光一寒，少年根本不给秦江伟时间，他耗费了巨大玄气，为的就是这一刻！
寒芒闪过，黝黑的大剑毫无阻碍的没入了其心口，鲜血迸射，在烈日下显得极为刺眼，流满了一地。
胜死崖崖顶，在众多不可思议的目光下，黑衣少年兀自矗立着，就如那把黝黑大剑一般，虽平淡无奇，却光芒十足，锐气十足！
死，死了？
炼体九重圆满的秦江伟败了？
底下上百名秦家子弟愣住了，四府府主秦龙愣住了，秦云天愣住了，另外两大府主以及众多长老也愣住了，就算秦家老祖，此刻同样一脸震撼。
越阶挑战在秦家不是没有，只是像如此这般连越三阶，却是史无前例的第一次，况且，对方已经达到了九重圆满！
要知道，这已经算是半只脚踏入气海镜了，就如秦家老祖所说，只要给秦江伟几天时间，怕是就能突破气海镜，可就是这样一名强者，竟然死在炼体六重的手中？
还有，最后一招剑招到底是怎么回事？为何如此强大？连炼体九重圆满都能斩杀！

所有人在这一刻都充满了疑惑，脑海中不断回想着刚才那恐怖的一剑。
“混蛋！秦轩小子，还我儿命来！”
兀的，一道充满凄厉的嘶吼骤然响起，只见秦龙双眼血红，整个人如疯癫了一般朝缓步下来的黑衣少年杀去，恐怖的玄气使得前方纷纷让出一条大道，实力较弱的人甚至吓得瘫倒在地。
望着那近乎毁灭性的一拳，秦轩神情淡然，根本无闪躲的意思，也闪躲不了，对方可是凝神镜前期的强者，不过他却丝毫不紧张，嘴角甚至还噙着一抹嘲讽。
“哼！秦龙，你这是反了不成？”果不其然，随着一声冷哼，只见秦云天同样飞身而来，立在少年的身前，玄气涌动，右拳猛然挥出，直取秦龙的胸口。
一名凝神镜前期，一名凝神镜中期，两人瞬间爆发的力量顿时令人群纷纷色变，迅速朝后狂退，生怕被那两股恐怖的能量波及。
然而，这时候又是一道人影来到了三人中间，带着无可匹敌之势一掌拍在二位府主的胸口。
嘭，嘭！
仅仅只是一接触，在一群秦家子弟惊骇的目光下，平时高高在上，不可匹敌的两位府主竟是纷纷在这一掌下飞了出去。
“够了！难道你们还闲丢人丢不够吗！”秦家老祖一脸厉色，这些子孙真是越来越不像话了，随后转头看向明显愣住的黑衣少年，脸色这才缓和了下来，还好，还好秦家有这小子。
秦龙从地面起来，刚才老祖那一掌并没有任何伤害，只是将他们击飞而已，可尽管如此，他的脸色依旧阴沉得可怕，仿佛能拧出水来一般，双眼通红，强忍着怒火，颤抖着指着黑衣少年低声吼道，“老祖，杀了他，杀了他！为江伟报仇！”
见此，秦家老祖不由得皱了皱眉，不等其说话，秦云天连道，“老祖，胜死崖本就是一死一活，秦轩根本没办法选择，还请老祖放过秦轩！”
“秦云天！秦轩残害同族，难道你还要包庇他吗？”
“你……”
“秦轩见过老祖。”终于，秦轩从后面走了上来，对着眼前老者微微鞠躬，从刚才的对话中，他可知道眼前这位看似普通的老者，正是秦家老祖，那位神秘莫测，一手开辟整个秦家的存在。
“哦？小家伙，你有什么可说的吗？”秦家老祖双眼微眯，若有所思的望着少年。
点了点头，先示意自己父亲放心，秦轩不理秦龙那吃人的目光，缓缓的说道，“二叔，你说我残害同族，可是当初在东府大厅，我与秦江伟定下这生死之约时，怎么不见你阻拦？”
“残害同族？笑话，当初你恐怕没料到今天这一幕吧？你肯定以为，从胜死崖下来的，必定是秦江伟吧？”
“的确，以秦江伟炼体九重圆满的实力确实必胜，可惜，他还是死了。”摇了摇头，似是在说一件遗憾的事情一般，随后神情不由得一凝，目光如炬，直视秦龙，“换句话说，我且问你，若是今天从上面下来的不是我秦轩，而是秦江伟，你可会说他残害同族？”
秦轩的声音极大，甚至灌入了玄气，周围一些秦家子弟也是纷纷点头，是啊，若是如今从胜死崖存活下来的是秦江伟，你秦龙会怪罪他吗？

显然不会，就如少年所说的一样，秦龙的确没料到最后活着的会是秦轩，秦轩若是死了，死了也就死了，可结果偏偏是该死的没死，能活下来的却死了，这极大的反差如何令他忍受得了，何况这死了的，还是他唯一的儿子！
几句话下来，秦龙根本无从反驳，要不是旁边有秦家老祖镇守着，恐怕早已上前将秦轩大卸八块，如果目光能杀人的话，秦轩怕是已经死了上千上万次了。
看着少年，秦家老祖眼里闪过一丝满意，“没错，事已至此，便就此散去了吧。”
闻言，一直精神紧绷的秦云天这才松了口气，若是秦轩真的出了什么事，他真不知道怎么跟他九泉之下的母亲交代，然而秦龙却是急了。
“老祖！”
“别再多说了，老夫意已决，秦江伟虽说身死，可只能说明技不如人罢了，回去后好好厚葬一番。”老祖喝道，不理会秦龙那近乎苍白的脸色，随后转头看向少年，“至于秦轩，回去养好伤势，三天后来秦家后山龙阁找老夫。”
说罢，不再理会众人，身形微微一闪，人却已经不知哪去，只在原地留下一道残影。
瞥了一眼秦龙，秦轩在秦云天以及东府几名长老的守护下飘然而去，剩下的秦家子弟一见事情似乎解决了，也都一一离去。
除了西府外，对于其他三府来说，死了个秦江伟而已，没什么大不了的，只是对于那老者有些好奇，他们因为离得远，可没听清秦云天与秦龙对老者的称呼，纷纷猜测起来，到底是谁能令两大府主如此乖乖听话。
“噗。”
一口逆血，秦龙在西府一干长老搀扶下这才稳住了身形，双眼阴鹫的望着少年离去的背影，压制许久的杀气终于忍不住喷薄而出，恐怖的杀气瞬间凝聚成一股阴风，令剩余的几人顿时觉得毛骨悚然。
“府主，现在该怎么办？”
“忍！”
近乎从牙齿中挤出这个字，秦龙眼中难掩怒火，老祖宗发话，他现在不得不听，至少在那个计划实行之前，他还不想与秦家决裂，只是一想到自己儿子身死，心中难免一阵愤怒。
他也想现在就将秦轩至于死地，可是现在想对付秦轩？笑话，难道你没看到老祖对那小子明显偏袒吗？
若是秦轩一旦出现什么事，老祖肯定会怪罪到他的头上！
现在秦龙不仅要忍，还要保证秦轩的安全！
“难道就这样算了吗？公子就这样白白死了吗？”西府长老个个神情愤慨，凄然，也不知是真是假。
“算了？”秦龙脸上渐渐浮现一抹疯狂之色，嘴角勾起一道狞笑，“等着吧，早晚有一天，我要让整个秦家为我儿江伟陪葬！哈哈……”
（三更完毕，推荐有木有，…）

Chapter 9 Qin Long’s Madness (Third update completed)
"It's over..."
"This little guy actually showed such a big flaw at this time!" The ancestor of the Qin family shook his head, with a hint of unbearability in his eyes. In his opinion, Qin Xuan was definitely destined to die at this time...
Everyone could not help but close their eyes, shake their heads and sigh.
"Look!"
At this moment, someone shouted something, and everyone couldn't help but look up again. When they saw it, they were so shocked that their eyes almost fell off. Even the ancestor of the Qin family almost bit his tongue and stared at the top of the cliff.
I saw the phantom of a huge sword appearing on the top of the cliff. The terrifying aura caused strong winds on the top of the cliff. Maybe others didn't know the power of this sword, but Qin Jiangwei felt it deeply under the sword. It was so overwhelming that he couldn't breathe!
Just when Qin Jiangwei was wondering why the young man could burst out with such powerful power, the dark giant sword had already reached above his head. Before he had time to think about it, Qin Jiangwei quickly turned his attack into defense and raised his sword horizontally to meet him.
As soon as he made contact, Qin Jiangwei's face suddenly changed wildly. He felt a huge force coming from the sword. He dwarfed and fell to his knees with a bang. The gravel on the ground instantly turned into powder.
But before he could get angry, the profound energy in his body stagnated inexplicably, as if the profound energy in his body was sealed by something. Although he had enough profound energy, he couldn't use it at all. This discovery immediately made Qin Jiangwei panic!
"Now!"
With a cold look in his eyes, the young man didn't give Qin Jiangwei any time. He spent a huge amount of profound energy just for this moment!
A cold light flashed, and the dark sword sank into his heart without any hindrance. Blood spurted out, which looked extremely dazzling under the scorching sun, and flowed all over the ground.
On the top of the Shengsheng Cliff, under the eyes of many incredible eyes, the young man in black stood alone, just like the dark sword, although it was plain and unremarkable, it was full of radiance and sharpness!
Dead, dead?
Qin Jiangwei, who had reached the ninth level of body refining, was defeated?
Hundreds of Qin family disciples below were stunned. Qin Long, the master of the fourth palace, was stunned. Qin Yuntian was stunned. The other two palace masters and many elders were also stunned. Even the ancestor of the Qin family was shocked at this moment.
It is not that there are no challenges in the Qin family, but it is an unprecedented first time to cross three levels in a row like this. Moreover, the opponent has already reached the ninth level of perfection!
You know, this is already half a foot into the Qi Sea Mirror. As the ancestor of the Qin family said, as long as Qin Jiangwei is given a few days, he may be able to break through the Qi Sea Mirror. But such a strong man died in the hands of the sixth level of body refining?
Also, what happened to the last sword move? Why is it so powerful? Even the ninth level of body refining can be killed!
Everyone was full of doubts at this moment, and their minds kept thinking about the terrifying sword just now.
"Asshole! Boy Qin Xuan, give back my son's life!"
Suddenly, a shrill roar suddenly sounded, and Qin Long's eyes were bloodshot, and he was going crazy as if he was killing the black-clothed young man who was slowly coming down. The terrifying mysterious energy made a road open in front of him, and the weaker ones even collapsed to the ground in fear.
Looking at the nearly devastating punch, Qin Xuan looked indifferent. He had no intention of dodging and could not dodge. The opponent was a strong man in the early stage of Ningshenjing, but he was not nervous at all, and there was even a hint of ridicule in the corner of his mouth.
"Hmph! Qin Long, are you rebelling?" Sure enough, with a cold snort, Qin Yuntian also flew over and stood in front of the young man, with profound energy surging, his right fist suddenly swung out and struck Qin Long's chest.
One was in the early stage of the Concentrating Mirror, and the other was in the middle stage of the Concentrating Mirror. The two people's instantaneous burst of power immediately made the crowd change their expressions, and they quickly retreated backwards, for fear of being affected by the two terrifying energies.
However, at this time, another figure came to the middle of the three people, and slapped the two of them with an unrivaled force.The palace lord’s chest.
Bang, bang!
With just a touch, under the horrified gazes of a group of Qin family disciples, the two palace masters who were usually aloof and invincible actually flew out under this palm.
"That's enough! Don't you have enough time to embarrass others?" The ancestor of the Qin family looked stern. These descendants were getting more and more outrageous. Then he turned to look at the obviously stunned young man in black, and then his expression softened. Fortunately, fortunately, the Qin family has this kid.
Qin Long got up from the ground. His ancestor's palm just now did no harm, it just knocked them away. However, despite this, his face was still terrifyingly gloomy, as if he could squeeze out water. His eyes were red, and he suppressed his anger. He pointed at the young man in black and shouted in a low voice, "Ancestor, kill him, kill him! Avenge Jiang Wei!"
Seeing this, the ancestor of the Qin family couldn't help but frowned, and before he could speak, Qin Yuntian said, "Ancestor, winning the Death Cliff is a matter of life and death. Qin Xuan has no choice at all. Please let Qin Xuan go!"
"Qin Yuntian! Qin Xuan harmed his own people, do you still want to protect him?"
"You..."
"Qin Xuan has met the ancestor." Finally, Qin Xuan came up from behind and bowed slightly to the old man in front of him. From the conversation just now, he knew that the seemingly ordinary old man in front of him was the ancestor of the Qin family, the mysterious one who single-handedly opened up the existence of the entire Qin family.
"Oh? Little guy, do you have anything to say?" The ancestor of the Qin family narrowed his eyes and looked at the young man thoughtfully.
Nodding, first to reassure his father, Qin Xuan ignored Qin Long's cannibalistic gaze and said slowly, "Second uncle, you said that I harmed my own people, but when I made this life-and-death agreement with Qin Jiangwei in the East Mansion Hall, why didn't you stop me?"
"Murturing a fellow tribesman? What a joke. I'm afraid you didn't expect what happened today, right? You must have thought that the one who came down from the cliff of victory and death must be Qin Jiangwei, right?"
"Indeed, with Qin Jiangwei's strength at the ninth level of body refining, he is sure to win, but unfortunately, he still died." He shook his head, as if saying something regrettable, and then his expression couldn't help but condense, and he looked directly at Qin Long, "In other words, let me ask you, if it was not me, Qin Xuan, but Qin Jiangwei who came down from above today, would you say that he harmed his own people?"
Qin Xuan's voice was loud and even filled with profound energy. Some of the Qin family disciples around him also nodded. Yes, if it is Qin Jiangwei who survives from Shengshengya Cliff now, will you, Qin Long, blame him?
Obviously not, just as the young man said, Qin Long did not expect that Qin Xuan would be the last to live. If Qin Xuan died, he would die, but the result was that the damned ones did not die, and the ones who could survive died. How could he bear this huge contrast, not to mention that the one who died was his only son!
After a few words, Qin Long had no way to refute. If it weren't for the ancestor of the Qin family guarding him, he would have stepped forward and cut Qin Xuan into pieces. If eyes could kill, Qin Xuan would have died thousands of times.
Looking at the young man, a trace of satisfaction flashed in the eyes of the ancestor of the Qin family, "Yes, the matter is over, let's let it go."
Hearing this, Qin Yuntian, who had been tense all the time, breathed a sigh of relief. If something really happened to Qin Xuan, he really didn't know how to explain it to his mother who was under the influence of Jiuquan. However, Qin Long was anxious.
"Ancestor!"
"Don't say any more, I have made up my mind. Although Qin Jiangwei died, it can only mean that his skills are not as good as others. He will give him a good burial when he returns." The ancestor shouted, ignoring Qin Long's almost pale face, and then turned to look at the young man, "As for Qin Xuan, go back and recover from your injuries. Find me in three days at the Dragon Pavilion at the back of the Qin family."
Having said that, he stopped paying attention to everyone, and his figure flashed slightly, but he no longer knew where he was going, leaving only an afterimage in the same place.
Glancing at Qin Long, Qin Xuan saw several people in Qin Yuntian and Dongfu.He drifted away under the protection of an elder. Seeing that the matter seemed to be resolved, the remaining Qin family disciples also left one by one.
Except for the west Palace, for the other three palaces, the death of Qin Jiangwei was not a big deal, but they were a little curious about the old man. Because they were far away, they did not hear clearly what Qin Yuntian and Qin Long called the old man, and they all started to guess who could make the two palace masters so obedient.
"Pfft."
With a mouthful of blood, Qin Long stabilized his figure with the help of a group of elders from the Xi Mansion. He looked at the young man's leaving figure with sinister eyes. The murderous aura that had been suppressed for a long time finally burst out. The terrifying murderous aura instantly condensed into a sinister wind, making the remaining people feel horrified.
"Master, what should we do now?"
"Forbearance!"
Almost squeezing the word out of his teeth, Qin Long couldn't hide the anger in his eyes. His ancestor had spoken, and he had to listen now. At least before the plan was implemented, he didn't want to break with the Qin family, but when he thought of his son's death, he couldn't help but feel angry in his heart.
He also wants to kill Qin Xuan now, but now he wants to deal with Qin Xuan? What a joke, didn’t you see the ancestor’s obvious favoritism towards that boy?
If anything happens to Qin Xuan, the ancestor will definitely blame him!
Now Qin Long not only has to endure it, but also ensures Qin Xuan's safety!
"Is this the end of it? Did the young master die like this in vain?" All the elders of Xifu looked angry and sad, and they didn't know whether it was true or not.
"Forget it?" A look of madness gradually appeared on Qin Long's face, and a sinister smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, "Just wait, sooner or later, I will let the entire Qin family be buried with my son Jiang Wei! Haha..."
